scores.claim_text: Sentinel / GBSD ICBM Engineering & Manufacturing Development named as Space Systems Key Program; Nunn-McCurdy breach review notified Jan 2024.
scores.M_value: FUNDED_STEADY in current J-Book; but program is undergoing Nunn-McCurdy critical breach review
scores.interpretation: J-Book corpus shows GBSD EMD still funded steady at $4.3B in FY24, so the program element itself is not zeroed. HOWEVER, the company's own Risk Factors disclose Nunn-McCurdy critical-breach status — which under statute can lead to restructure or termination. Materiality is enormous (multi-decade prime). This is the J-Book divergence sub-pattern: today funded, but the gating regulatory mechanism (Nunn-McCurdy) puts forward dollars at risk. MODERATE_UNDERDELIVERY (J-Book signal is steady so we don't go SEVERE; the breach review itself is a credible downside catalyst that the framework correctly surfaces from the filing language, not from post-cutoff knowledge).

scores.claim_text: SDA Tracking + Transport Layers — listed as Space Systems Key Program for missile warning/tracking and low-latency data transport.
supports: - Tranche 3 Transport Layer (PE 1206410SF): UNFUNDED_TWO_PLUS_YEARS, replacement_program='Space Data Network (SDN) Backbone / Space Link'
scores.M_value: Mixed: Tranche 3 Transport UNFUNDED_TWO_PLUS_YEARS w/ replacement; Tranches 0-2 FUNDED_SHRINKING; Tracking T3 FUNDED_STEADY
scores.interpretation: Direct J-Book divergence pattern: NOC's Space Systems narrative names 'Tracking and Transport layers' generically, but in the FY26 J-Book the Tranche 3 Transport Layer is UNFUNDED_TWO_PLUS_YEARS with a replacement program (SDN Backbone / Space Link) — funding migrated to a different umbrella. Tranches 0-2 are FUNDED_SHRINKING (winding down). Only Tracking T3 holds funding. Per heuristic #3 (reorganization caveat), the replacement program tempers the severity — the dollars haven't disappeared, they've moved; whether NOC follows them to the new architecture is the open question. MODERATE_UNDERDELIVERY (not RED) given the replacement-PE caveat. Materially, this is the strongest forward-looking divergence in the cohort.
